provenance.factory_hash_contract: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 Function.prototype.toString() for canonicalKernelFactories[key]
provenance.reference_only: all frozen expected outputs come from the pinned direct canonical CPU factory; mutation outputs are eval-created copies of that exact factory text with counted replacements

input.construction: top-down Float32Array at each case size: R=((17*x+31*y+13)%101)/100; G=((7*x+19*y+23)%97)/96; B=((29*x+11*y+5)%89)/88; A=(((5*x+7*y+3)%23)-5)/12; every lane assignment crosses the Float32Array boundary
input.storage: top-down Surface Float32Array; lane=(y*width+x)*4; dimensions equal each output case

fixture.sampler_orientation: input storage is top-down; canonical texelFetch maps GLSL bottom-left integer coordinates through Surface sampling
fixture.float_bytes: host little-endian Float32Array bytes; probe words use little-endian Uint32
fixture.verification: every canonical case double-renders with fresh input and destination surfaces and requires identical input F32, output F32, and output RGBA8 bytes before hashing; every output lane must be finite
fixture.note: the over-cap case deliberately exercises the direct binding domain outside the metadata UI maximum; it is a branch diagnostic, not a metadata-valid preset

mutation_sensitivity.purpose: prove the frozen fixture is sensitive to channel order, seed/simplex/time noise, shape frequency mapping, mask, direction, displacement cap, floating and integer wrap, both bilinear axes, and alpha behavior across the 17-function acyclic helper graph

mutations.name: channel-order-red-zero-to-blue-two
mutations.contract: changes only the red warped_channel_value selector from channel 0 to channel 2

replacements.from: var red = warped_channel_value(0, coord, base_pos, width_f, height_f, freq, clampedDisplacement, mask, time, speed);
replacements.to: var red = warped_channel_value(2, coord, base_pos, width_f, height_f, freq, clampedDisplacement, mask, time, speed);

mutations.name: direction-rotation-disabled
mutations.contract: sets dirRad to zero while retaining all noise and sampling work

mutations.name: wrap-index-next-neighbor-clamped
mutations.contract: replaces positive modulo wrapping of x1/y1 with last-index clamping

mutations.name: wrap-float-coordinate-clamped
mutations.contract: replaces periodic floating coordinate wrapping with clamping inside the last texel

mutations.name: bilinear-fx-forced-zero
mutations.contract: removes horizontal interpolation while retaining the four canonical fetches

mutations.name: bilinear-fy-forced-zero
mutations.contract: removes vertical interpolation while retaining the four canonical fetches

mutations.name: time-noise-branch-disabled
mutations.contract: disables only the second simplex/time-noise branch

mutations.name: singularity-mask-forced-one
mutations.contract: forces the main-path mask to one after retaining singularity_mask call-site shape as an exact replacement target

mutations.name: alpha-clamp-disabled
mutations.contract: preserves original alpha on the normal path instead of clamp01

mutations.name: displacement-cap-disabled
mutations.contract: uses the bound displacement directly instead of min(displacement,maxAllowedDisplacement)

mutations.name: simplex-amplitude-42-to-41
mutations.contract: changes the final simplex_noise amplitude only

replacements.from: return 42 * ((m0sq * m0sq) * (dot(g0n, x0)) + (m1sq * m1sq) * (dot(g1n, x1)) + (m2sq * m2sq) * (dot(g2n, x2)) + (m3sq * m3sq) * (dot(g3n, x3)));
replacements.to: return 41 * ((m0sq * m0sq) * (dot(g0n, x0)) + (m1sq * m1sq) * (dot(g1n, x1)) + (m2sq * m2sq) * (dot(g2n, x2)) + (m3sq * m3sq) * (dot(g3n, x3)));

mutations.name: frequency-axes-unswapped
mutations.contract: uses freq.x for x and freq.y for y instead of the canonical cross-axis mapping

replacements.from:
var freq_x = max(freq[1], 1);
  	var freq_y = max(freq[0], 1);
replacements.to:
var freq_x = max(freq[0], 1);
  	var freq_y = max(freq[1], 1);

mutations.name: seed-offset-disabled
mutations.contract: sets compute_noise_value seed_offset to zero while preserving channel offsets
